question: Does the frozen five-head program L9H1/H4 + L11H1/H3 + L15H5 reproduce the near-complete three-attention-module converter on a construction not used to select the auxiliary heads?

frozen_design.population: All 27 jointly capable A1/A2 rows selected only by the prior v10 native-capability manifest.
frozen_design.actuation: The exact weight-defined MLP8 post-cue hidden-product complement used by the confirmed v10 core experiment.
frozen_design.arms: Live complement; L9H1/H4; all L9 heads; frozen five-head union; all heads in L9/L11/L15; five leave-one-head arms; three leave-one-module arms; and native self-clamp.
frozen_design.comparison: Removed behavior and final-Q8 coordinates of the five-head union relative to the complete three-attention-module removal. No v10 head selection or fitting.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_self_clamp_finit: All hashes, 27-row population, prior L9H1/H4 replay, self-clamp, finite metrics, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_three_attention_route_is_material: All three modules remove at least 90% behavior and 90% Q8 norm of the live complement, with behavior/Q8 cosine at least .98 in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_five_head_program_is_sufficient: The five heads retain at least 80% behavior and 75% Q8 norm of the three-module removal, with behavior/Q8 cosine at least .98/.95 in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_each_module_contributes_to_the_fi: Leaving out all selected heads from any one of L9, L11, or L15 worsens behavior or Q8 relative error in both panels; individual leave-one effects are reported without requiring every head separately necessary.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_prospective_confirmation: No v10 outcome changes the head set, rank, groups, thresholds, or weights; no gradients or updates.

decision: Screen promotes a transferable five-head near-complete converter and licenses exact c_v/c_proj/source-factor compilation for L11H1/H3 and L15H5. Null preserves the full three-attention route and redirects only the head compression.
